name: Fast Food Drive-thru
place: A fast food restaurant drive-thru window
speaker: Cashier

tasks.goal: Greet the drive-thru cashier and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the drive-thru cashier and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Order a cheeseburger combo meal with medium french fries
tasks.hint: State your meal order clearly at speaker box.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered cheeseburger combo meal with fries.

tasks.goal: Upgrade drink selection to large iced tea with no ice
tasks.hint: Specify beverage customization preferences.
tasks.done_when: Learner upgraded drink size and specified no ice.

tasks.goal: Ask if grilled chicken sandwich can be made without mayonnaise
tasks.hint: Request ingredient omission on sandwich.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested sandwich modification without mayo.
tasks.scene_hint: Intercom speaker crackles while car engine idling sounds in drive-thru lane.

tasks.goal: Inquire about available dipping sauces for chicken nuggets
tasks.hint: Ask cashier what sauce choices are included.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about dipping sauce options.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'combo'
tasks.hint: Combo means meal bundle. Ask what is included in the combo.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'combo'.

tasks.goal: Ask if breakfast menu items are still being served
tasks.hint: Inquire about breakfast menu cutoff time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about breakfast menu availability.

tasks.goal: Request adding extra slice of cheese after initially placing order
tasks.hint: Add item to order before moving to payment window.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested order addition at drive-thru window.

tasks.goal: Inquire about kid meal toy options available today
tasks.hint: Ask what toy comes with child meal.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about kid meal toy selection.

tasks.goal: Politely point out missing side of fries at pickup window
tasks.hint: Check bag contents and report missing item.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing fries at drive-thru window.
tasks.scene_hint: Drive-thru window slides open emitting aroma of fried potatoes and grilled meat.

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile app rewards barcode can be scanned at window
tasks.hint: Inquire about redeeming digital coupon.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about scanning mobile rewards code.

tasks.goal: Confirm total price displayed on window payment screen
tasks.hint: Verify charge total with drive-thru cashier.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed drive-thru total payment.

tasks.goal: Request printed paper receipt and itemized order breakdown
tasks.hint: Ask for printed receipt at window.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed drive-thru receipt.

tasks.goal: Ask for extra napkins and condiment packets in takeaway bag
tasks.hint: Request extra ketchup and napkins before driving off.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra napkins and condiments.

tasks.goal: Thank the drive-thru cashier and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the drive-thru cashier AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about family meal value deals available at drive-thru
tasks.hint: Ask cashier about large family bundle options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about family meal value deals.
tasks.scene_hint: An illuminated drive-thru menu board glows warmly above the car lane as ordering static crackles.

tasks.goal: Ask for assistance choosing between crispy chicken and spicy tenders
tasks.hint: Ask cashier to compare chicken tender spice levels.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help choosing between crispy chicken and tenders.
tasks.scene_hint: Sizzling oil sounds drift from the kitchen window along with the smell of fried chicken.

tasks.goal: Inquire about plant-based veggie burger patty options
tasks.hint: Ask if vegetarian burger patty is available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about plant-based burger patty options.
tasks.scene_hint: Green plant-based emblem icons flash on the digital order preview monitor at the window.

tasks.goal: Confirm bag is sealed with safety sticker before driving away
tasks.hint: Ask cashier to ensure bag tamper seal is intact.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed bag safety sticker seal.
tasks.scene_hint: A paper bag stamped with a red tamper-evident safety sticker is handed across the window ledge.

tasks.goal: Ask about drive-thru lane wait times during peak hours
tasks.hint: Inquire how fast drive-thru lane moves.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about drive-thru wait times.
tasks.scene_hint: Exhaust fumes rise from idling sedans queued in the narrow drive-thru lane.

tasks.goal: Request survey receipt code for free dessert on next visit
tasks.hint: Ask cashier if receipt contains feedback code.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested receipt survey feedback code.
tasks.scene_hint: A long paper receipt printed with a feedback survey code sticks out from the register printer.

tasks.goal: Confirm drive-thru operating hours for 24-hour service
tasks.hint: Ask cashier if drive-thru window stays open all night.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed 24-hour drive-thru operating hours.
tasks.scene_hint: A glowing 24-hour service sign hums softly above the drive-thru payment window.

tasks.goal: Ask if digital receipt can be emailed via mobile app account
tasks.hint: Request digital purchase receipt sent to app account.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for digital receipt via mobile app.
tasks.scene_hint: A barcode scanner beeps at the drive-thru window as mobile phones swipe for payment.

tasks.goal: Confirm cup holder divider stability in takeaway bag
tasks.hint: Ask cashier to ensure drink tray does not tip over.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed cup holder stability in bag.
tasks.scene_hint: Cardboard four-cup drink carriers sit stacked on a stainless steel shelf beside the window.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'intercom'
tasks.hint: Intercom is the two-way speaker system used at drive-thru lanes. Apologize if your voice was unclear over the intercom.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'intercom'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'trans fat'
tasks.hint: Trans fat refers to unsaturated industrial fats in fried food. Inquire if the cooking oil contains trans fat.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'trans fat'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'sodium'
tasks.hint: Sodium refers to salt content in processed food. Inquire about the sodium content of the fried chicken.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'sodium'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'franchise'
tasks.hint: Franchise is an individually owned restaurant chain location. Ask if this franchise honors nationwide promotions.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'franchise'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about gluten-free bun substitute for hamburger
tasks.hint: Ask if gluten-free bread options are available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gluten-free bun substitutes.
tasks.scene_hint: A plastic tray containing wrapped gluten-free burger buns rests near the warming station.

tasks.goal: Ask if french fries can be ordered with no added salt
tasks.hint: Request unsalted french fries freshly fried.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for french fries without added salt.
tasks.scene_hint: A metal fry scoop rests in a heated stainless steel bin of unsalted golden fries.

tasks.goal: Request double bacon burger with extra onion rings on side
tasks.hint: Specify burger toppings and side item choice.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered double bacon burger with extra onion rings.

tasks.goal: Inquire about milk option for kid meal beverage
tasks.hint: Ask if low-fat milk carton can replace soft drink.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about milk options for kid meal drink.

tasks.goal: Address issue where drink cup lid is leaking around rim
tasks.hint: Ask cashier for replacement cup lid at window.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested replacement drink cup lid.

tasks.goal: Ask about limited-time promotional sauce releases
tasks.hint: Inquire if new seasonal dipping sauce is in stock.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about promotional sauce options.

tasks.goal: Request light ice in soft drink cup
tasks.hint: Ask cashier to fill drink cup with light ice.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested light ice in soft drink.

tasks.goal: Inquire if restaurant offers catering platters for sports events
tasks.hint: Ask about party platter options for pickup.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about catering platter availability.

tasks.goal: Ask about calorie count comparison between fried and grilled options
tasks.hint: Inquire about nutrition info printed on menu.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about calorie counts for menu items.

tasks.goal: Request extra burger wrapping paper for messy meal
tasks.hint: Ask cashier for extra paper wrap around burger.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra burger wrapping paper.

tasks.goal: Inquire about milk tea tapioca pearl availability
tasks.hint: Ask if specialty tea beverages are served.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about milk tea beverage options.

tasks.goal: Report receiving wrong drink flavor at pickup window
tasks.hint: Point out soda flavor mistake to cashier.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported receiving wrong drink flavor.

tasks.goal: Ask about fish fillet sandwich tartar sauce ingredients
tasks.hint: Inquire if tartar sauce contains pickles or dill.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tartar sauce ingredients.

tasks.goal: Request cashier hold sauce on side instead of on bun
tasks.hint: Ask for dipping sauce served in cup.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested sauce served on the side.

tasks.goal: Inquire about mozzarella stick appetizer box availability
tasks.hint: Ask if fried cheese sticks are on side menu.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mozzarella stick availability.

tasks.goal: Ask if drive-thru accepts gift cards purchased at grocery stores
tasks.hint: Verify gift card acceptance at window.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gift card acceptance.

tasks.goal: Report cold french fries served at pickup window
tasks.hint: Inform cashier that fries are not hot and ask for fresh batch.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported cold french fries and requested fresh batch.

tasks.goal: Inquire about spicy level customization on chicken wings
tasks.hint: Ask if wings can be tossed in extra hot sauce.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about wing spicy level options.

tasks.goal: Ask if breakfast burrito meal includes hash brown patty
tasks.hint: Inquire what side item comes with breakfast burrito.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about breakfast meal side inclusions.

tasks.goal: Request extra straw and drink carrier for four large sodas
tasks.hint: Ask cashier for cardboard drink carrier tray.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested drink carrier and extra straws.

tasks.goal: Inquire about apple pie dessert baked fresh schedule
tasks.hint: Ask if warm turnover pies were recently baked.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about apple pie fresh baking schedule.

tasks.goal: Ask about double cheeseburger patty weight in ounces
tasks.hint: Inquire about meat portion sizes on burger menu.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about burger patty weight specs.

tasks.goal: Report missing straw for beverage in drive-thru bag
tasks.hint: Inform cashier that drink straw was omitted.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing drink straw.

tasks.goal: Inquire about egg white substitution on breakfast sandwich
tasks.hint: Ask if real egg whites can replace fried egg.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about egg white substitutions.

tasks.goal: Ask if drive-thru lane accommodates oversized commercial vans
tasks.hint: Inquire about drive-thru overhead height clearance limit.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about drive-thru height clearance limits.

tasks.goal: Request cashier add extra barbecue sauce packet before closing bag
tasks.hint: Ask for additional sauce packet.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra barbecue sauce packet.

tasks.goal: Inquire about frozen slushie machine flavor availability
tasks.hint: Ask which slushie flavors are currently frozen and ready.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about frozen slushie machine flavors.

tasks.goal: Ask if single item can be purchased without full combo
tasks.hint: Inquire about ala carte pricing for sandwich only.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about purchasing sandwich ala carte.

tasks.goal: Report burger made with pickles despite requesting no pickles
tasks.hint: Point out order modification error to cashier.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported pickles on burger despite custom request.

tasks.goal: Inquire about allergen information for peanut oil frying
tasks.hint: Ask what oil type is used in deep fryers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about frying oil allergen information.

tasks.goal: Ask if drive-thru offers touchless card reader payment
tasks.hint: Inquire if tap pay terminal works at window.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about touchless card reader support.

tasks.goal: Request cashier swap french fries for onion rings after order
tasks.hint: Ask to modify side item before paying.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested swapping french fries for onion rings.

tasks.goal: Inquire about jalapeno pepper add-on cost for cheeseburger
tasks.hint: Ask how much extra spicy pepper toppings cost.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about jalapeno add-on cost.

tasks.goal: Ask if coffee syrup options include sugar-free vanilla
tasks.hint: Inquire about coffee flavoring syrup choices.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sugar-free coffee syrup options.

tasks.goal: Report bag tear at pickup window and ask for new bag
tasks.hint: Inform cashier that paper bag ripped at bottom.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported torn paper bag and requested replacement.

tasks.goal: Inquire about chocolate chip cookie warm baked availability
tasks.hint: Ask if cookies are served warm from oven.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about warm chocolate chip cookies.

tasks.goal: Request cashier double check nugget count in ten-piece box
tasks.hint: Ask cashier to verify chicken nugget piece count.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested verification of nugget piece count.

tasks.goal: Inquire about breakfast meal hours on weekend mornings
tasks.hint: Ask what time breakfast service ends on Sundays.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about weekend breakfast menu hours.

tasks.goal: Inquire about side salad dressing flavor options
tasks.hint: Ask cashier what salad dressings are available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about side salad dressing options.

tasks.goal: Ask if drive-thru window serves hot chocolate in winter
tasks.hint: Inquire about warm winter beverages.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about hot chocolate availability.

tasks.goal: Request cashier verify total count of french fry bags in order
tasks.hint: Ask cashier to count fry boxes in bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested verification of fry count.
